goal: Record the successor for the ISL-2 coverage removed with tests/kernel-r2a-boundary.test.ts (an unrecognized runKernelCommand invocation refuses with invalid_command and writes nothing to authoritative state): tests/kernel-shadow-cli.test.ts already asserts this generically for an unknown command; extend it to also cover the literal 'readiness' token so the original scenario is preserved, not just an arbitrary placeholder string, and name it as ISL-2's successor.

acceptance.assertion: tests/kernel-shadow-cli.test.ts's unknown-command coverage additionally exercises runKernelCommand(['readiness', '--json']) (not only an arbitrary placeholder token), asserting returncode 2 / invalid_command, a rejected journal entry, and that .imm/state/workspace.json is not created; an inline comment names this as the successor for the ISL-2 coverage retired with tests/kernel-r2a-boundary.test.ts at S5.
